data.description: Your name, email address, profile picture, and which shifts you booked. That's it. No tracking, no analytics, and only the cookies needed to keep you signed in.
data.title: We store very little

free.description: No paid tier, no ads, nothing to upsell. It's a private, non-commercial project provided as-is, without a guarantee of uninterrupted service.
free.title: Free, and honest about it

private.description: A new event is visible only to the people you invite. Making it public is a deliberate choice, and even then your organisers decide who actually gets in.
private.title: Private by default

about.lede: WirkSam was built for church events and community service, where the roster is usually a spreadsheet passed around by email until nobody knows which copy is real.
about.legalIntro: The full detail is in the small print:
about.nameExplainer: The name is a German pun: “wirksam” means effective, and “zusammen” means together. Volunteering works best when we work together — hence WirkSam.
about.title: A small project, run in the open

audience.lede: Somebody has to build the plan, and somebody has to show up on the day. WirkSam is the one place where those two meet.

organiser.description: Everything you would otherwise keep in a spreadsheet and chase over email — who is covering what, and which slots are still empty.
organiser.label: For organisers

points.0: Set up an event yourself — nobody has to approve it.
points.1: Invite your team by email or with one share link.
points.2: Describe a task once; every shift is generated from it.
points.3: See at a glance which shifts are still short of people.

organiser.title: You run the event

audience.title: Two sides of the same roster

volunteer.description: No spreadsheet to decipher and no reply-all thread. Your shifts, in one list, with a reminder before each one.
volunteer.label: For volunteers

points.0: Open the invitation, sign in, and you're in.
points.1: Say when you're free before the shifts are handed out.
points.2: Book what fits, cancel in good time if plans change.
points.3: A reminder before every shift, on the channel you use.

volunteer.title: You lend a hand

features.lede: Generate the shifts, share one plan, keep track of who is coming, and remind them in time.

availability.description: Collect who can be there when, and see the whole team's availability as a heatmap before you start assigning.
availability.title: Availability up front

calendarFeed.description: A private feed URL puts your booked shifts into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook and keeps them up to date.
calendarFeed.title: Calendar subscription

discover.description: Leave an event private, or make it public so anyone signed in can ask to join — and your organisers decide who gets in.
discover.title: Public events, if you want them

languages.description: The whole app in both languages, in two colour palettes, on a phone as readily as a laptop.
languages.title: German and English, light and dark

people.description: Owner, organiser, and member per event. Promote someone, hand the event over, or step back — an event can never end up with nobody in charge.
people.title: Roles that match reality

reports.description: See how the work is spread across your team, and print a clean roster per task or for the whole event.
reports.title: Reports and printing

bookings.description: Everything you signed up for, soonest first. Only you or an organiser can cancel a booking.

points.0: Filter by what's coming up, this month, or everything.
points.1: Cancel in two clicks and the slot reopens for someone else.
points.2: Subscribe from your own calendar app and your shifts sit alongside the rest of your week.

bookings.screenshotAlt: The My Bookings page listing confirmed shifts with their dates, times, and locations.
bookings.title: Your commitments in one list

clone.description: Copy an event you have already run onto new dates. The tasks, the shifts and the times all come across, and the original is left exactly as it was.

points.0: Set the new dates once and everything moves with them, landing on the same weekday as last time.
points.1: Tick only the tasks that are coming back and leave the rest behind.
points.2: Last year's sign-ups stay with last year — the copy starts with empty shifts.

clone.screenshotAlt: The copy-event screen listing last year's tasks with their shift counts, each ticked to come across to the new dates.
clone.title: Next year, not from scratch

overview.description: Your event's tasks as a list, as cards, or on a calendar — with the open places showing on every shift.

points.0: Search and filter by category, location, or date.
points.1: Hide the shifts that are already full to see what still needs covering.
points.2: The whole app works on one event at a time, so nobody reads the wrong roster.

overview.screenshotAlt: The task list with a week of shifts beside each entry, showing booked and open places per slot.
overview.title: One plan, and everyone sees the same one

reminders.description: A roster only works if people remember. WirkSam nudges before each shift, on whichever channel you actually read.

points.0: Email, browser push, or Telegram — chosen per notification type.
points.1: Everything also lands in an inbox inside the app.
points.2: Turn any of it off. Reminders are an offer, not a nuisance.

reminders.screenshotAlt: Notification settings with a row per notification type and per-channel switches for email, push, and Telegram.
reminders.title: Reminders that actually reach people

shifts.description: You give a task its shape — the days, the daily hours, how long a shift runs, how many people it needs — and the shifts are generated from it.

points.0: Uneven days handled on purpose: drop the remainder, shorten the last shift, or stretch it.
points.1: Different hours on one date? Add an override without touching the rest.
points.2: A live preview lists every shift before it exists — click one to leave it out.

shifts.screenshotAlt: The shift schedule form beside a live preview of every shift it would create.
shifts.title: Describe the pattern once

features.title: Everything a roster needs

finalCta.lede: Sign in, create your event, and invite your team. Nobody has to approve you first.
finalCta.title: Ready to plan your next event?

board.summary: A roster board: three days across, four shifts down each day, each showing how many of its places are taken — most covered, a few still open, and one marked as yours.

hero.subtitle: Set up your event, invite your team, and describe the shifts once. Everyone books the slots that suit them — and gets a reminder before each one.
hero.title: Plan the roster for your next event — together.

journey.lede: Four steps, whichever side you are on.

organiser.footnote: Then print the roster, or pull a report on how the work is spread.

create.description: A name and the dates it runs. It's yours, and private until you say otherwise.
create.title: Create the event

generate.description: Describe a task once — days, hours, length, headcount — and every shift is worked out for you.
generate.title: Generate the shifts

invite.description: Paste a list of addresses, or send one share link. You pick each person's role.
invite.title: Invite your people

publish.description: Your team books the slots that suit them. You see the gaps as they close.
publish.title: Publish and watch it fill

journey.title: From an empty calendar to a covered event

volunteer.footnote: Plans changed? Cancel from My Bookings and the place reopens for somebody else.

accept.description: See the event, who invited you, and your role — before you decide.
accept.title: Accept the invitation

availability.description: Whole days, a daily window, or exact hours painted into a grid.
availability.title: Say when you're free

book.description: Pick the slots that fit. Each one shows how many places are left.
book.title: Book your shifts

reminders.description: A nudge before each shift by email, push, or Telegram — your choice.
reminders.title: Get reminded

lightbox.title: Screenshot

cookies.description: WirkSam uses only technically necessary cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics.
cookies.title: Cookies

dataCollected.intro: When you create an account and use WirkSam, we process the following personal data:

items.bookings: Booking data (which duty shifts you signed up for)
items.credentials: Your password, stored only as a salted hash — never in readable form — together with the sign-in sessions on your devices
items.name: Name (as you enter it when you register)

dataCollected.title: Data We Collect

privacy.intro: We take the protection of your personal data seriously. This privacy policy explains what data we collect when you use WirkSam, how we use it, and what rights you have.

legalBasis.description: We process your data based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract) for core account and booking functionality, and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest) for security and platform operation. Where we send optional notifications, we rely on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time in your notification settings.
legalBasis.title: Legal Basis

items.account: To create and manage your user account
items.notifications: To send you notifications about your bookings and tasks (email, push, or Telegram if configured)
items.scheduling: To enable duty scheduling and shift booking
items.security: To ensure the security and proper operation of the platform

retention.description: Your personal data is stored as long as your account is active. If you request account deletion, we will erase your personal data without undue delay, unless we are legally required to retain it.
retention.title: Data Retention

rights.contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the email address listed above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
rights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

items.access: Right of access — request a copy of your personal data
items.erasure: Right to erasure — request deletion of your data
items.objection: Right to object — object to processing based on legitimate interest
items.portability: Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured format
items.rectification: Right to rectification — correct inaccurate data
items.restriction: Right to restriction — limit how we process your data

rights.title: Your Rights

email.description: We use Proton Mail to send transactional emails such as booking confirmations and notifications. Proton AG is based in Switzerland and subject to Swiss data protection law. Only your email address and the message content are processed.
email.title: Proton Mail (Proton AG)

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

items.accuracy: You are responsible for keeping your account information accurate and up to date.
items.approval: Account access may require approval by an administrator. We reserve the right to reject or deactivate accounts.
items.registration: You need to create an account with your email address and a password to use WirkSam.
items.security: You are responsible for the security of your account credentials.

availability.description: WirkSam is provided as-is, without guarantees of uninterrupted availability. We strive to keep the platform running reliably, but maintenance windows, outages, or changes may occur. We will try to communicate planned downtime in advance.
availability.title: Service Availability

bookings.description: When you book a duty shift, you commit to being available at the scheduled time and place. If you can no longer attend, please cancel your booking as early as possible so the shift can be filled by someone else. Organizers and administrators may cancel or reassign bookings if necessary.
bookings.title: Bookings & Cancellations

usage.intro: When using WirkSam, you agree to:

items.lawful: Use the platform only for its intended purpose of volunteer duty scheduling.
items.noAbuse: Not attempt to manipulate, overload, or exploit the platform.
items.reliable: Honor your booked duty shifts or cancel in a timely manner if you cannot attend.
items.respectful: Be respectful to other users and organizers.

usage.title: Acceptable Use
